purpose: Check whether one explicit owner/status audit after normal tracking repairs the known focal failures without damaging correct states.
input_contract: The normal tracker receives only each row.input. Audit receives arrived raw dialogue and ALL existing post-tracker intents, including withdrawn; never focal IDs, fault kind, references, expected metadata, preserve_ids, scenario labels, or review notes.
procedure: Freeze these cases and the implementation/prompt before inference.
For each input, generate and apply one normal-tracker proposal using the fixed current v2 LoRA.
Run at most one audit with the same loaded base and adapter over every existing post-tracker record; retain the normal result as the paired baseline.
Preserve failures, truncations and rejected audits; no output-dependent sample selection, prompt tuning, retry or additional model arm.
Review raw source meaning and changed-field citations separately from structural coverage.
primary_outcome: Focal existing stable-ID owner and status both correct against the predeclared reference after the normal step and after audit; score meaning/text separately so metadata correctness is not called full intent correctness.
secondary_outcomes: Changes from baseline-correct to wrong owner/status on every audited record, not only the focal record.
Fault target corrections, remaining errors, clean-target damage and newly unsupported changes.
Strict report coverage, accepted/rejected/unresolved results and changes supported by sufficient cited arrived user evidence.
Audit preserves text and record IDs exactly; absent or newly misidentified baseline intents require explicit manual matching or an unscorable flag, never arbitrary ID matching.
Normal plus audit calls/tokens/time; audit consumes additional compute, so no matched-budget superiority claim.
interpretation_rule: A functional audit requires valid behavior, not just completed calls. Meeting the desired checks is acceptance on these exposed cases; a repair benefit additionally requires observed baseline-to-audit corrections with no offsetting damage. Do not claim held-out generalization, causal mechanism, statistical superiority, or production reliability.
stop_rule: One frozen implementation and one bounded acceptance collection. If the focal capability does not work or causes regressions, report it and stop this scope; do not add prompt sweeps, new models, retraining or a larger evaluation.
limitations: Previously exposed synthetic examples and model-authored/model-reviewed reference labels.
Five families with six prefixes and matched priors; 12 inputs are not 12 independent scenarios.
No real rollout, end-to-end task success, ASR, or user study is tested.
Correct-prior controls are original family histories; they can still require ordinary updates from the latest turn.
